name: Earth Taken
storyline: Earth Taken is set in a dystopian world devastated by an alien invasion. The environment is heavily polluted, and acid rain falls frequently, forcing the player to find shelter or use a gas mask to survive outdoors. The player controls a human survivor navigating through ruined landscapes, abandoned buildings, and underground bunkers.
